title: L2 Mania
tagline: An easy to use multi chain transaction explorer and bridger. Connect with multiple l2's, see there data and interact with transactions and send your assets across them
description:
It's very important to have an easy-to-use l2 tool through which we can track almost all the things around there on multiple layer2. It has following features:-
- Put Transaction. hash and it will find out transaction across all l2 and l1's
- Supports mantle, polygon zkevm, zksync era, gnosis, ethereum, scroll, taiko, optimism
- See all your assets across all chains
- Bridge Assets easily across chains
how_its_made:
